listing.name: Digimon World 3 — DigimonWorld3-Recomp (MikeRavenelle)
listing.summary: The project describes a beta that starts and plays, with known rough edges. A complete campaign is unconfirmed. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA SLUS-01436 CUE/BIN; follow setup’s identity checks.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow local setup to compile from your own disc using the bundled toolchain. An optional HD upscaler download has its own integrity check.

warnings: The project describes a beta that starts and plays, with known rough edges. A complete campaign is unconfirmed.
